fog.definition:
n. droplets of water vapor suspended in the air near the ground
n. an atmosphere in which visibility is reduced because of a cloud of some substance
fog.translation:
n. 雾, 迷惑, (割后的)最生草, 苔藓
vi. 被雾笼罩, 变模糊
vt. 使困惑, 以雾笼罩

fog index.translation: [网络] 迷雾指数；迷雾系数；福格指数

fog-horns.translation: (fog-horn 的复数) 雾角, [水运] 雾笛

fog-signals.translation: (fog-signal 的复数) n. 雾中信号

fogarty.translation: n. (Fogarty)人名；(法)福加尔蒂；(英)福格蒂

fogbank.definition: n. a large mass of fog on the sea (as seen from a distance)

fogbound.translation: a. 被雾笼罩的, 因大雾所阻而不能正常行驶的, 被浓雾所阻不能航行的

fogeater.translation: n. 雾虹, 雾中升起的满月

fogel.translation: n. (Fogel)人名；(英、俄、罗、匈、塞、瑞典)福格尔；(法)福热尔

fogerty.translation: [人名] [爱尔兰姓氏] 福格蒂 Fogarty的变体

fogey.definition: n someone whose style is out of fashion
fogey.translation: n. (思想)守旧者, 抱残守缺的人

fogeys.definition: n. someone whose style is out of fashion
fogeys.translation: n. （思想）守旧者, 抱残守缺的人( fogey的复数形式 )

foggara.translation: 沙漠地区用于供水的地下水管

fogged.translation: a. 有灰雾的；不清晰的

fogger.translation: n. 雾警信号手, 照顾牛马者

foggia.translation: n. 福贾（意大利东南部义大利牛岛上普利亚区福贾省的省会城市名）；福贾队（意大利的足球队名）

foggier.definition:
s. stunned or confused and slow to react (as from blows or drunkenness or exhaustion)
s. indistinct or hazy in outline
s. filled or abounding with fog or mist
foggier.translation: a. 有雾的( foggy的比较级 ); 雾气朦胧的; 模糊的; 混乱的

foggiest.definition:
s stunned or confused and slow to react (as from blows or drunkenness or exhaustion)
s indistinct or hazy in outline
s filled or abounding with fog or mist
s obscured by fog

foggily.definition: adv. In a foggy manner; obscurely.

fogginess.definition: n. The state of being foggy.

fogging.definition: v make less visible or unclear
fogging.translation:
[化] 成雾
[医] 迷惑试验

foggy.definition:
s stunned or confused and slow to react (as from blows or drunkenness or exhaustion)
s indistinct or hazy in outline
s filled or abounding with fog or mist
s obscured by fog
foggy.translation: a. 雾深的, 模糊的

foghorn.definition:
n. a loud low warning signal that can be heard by fogbound ships
n. a warning device consisting of a horn that generates a loud low tone
foghorn.translation: n. 雾号, 响而尖的声音

foghorns.definition:
n. a loud low warning signal that can be heard by fogbound ships
n. a warning device consisting of a horn that generates a loud low tone
foghorns.translation: n. （大雾时发出响亮而低沉的声音以警告其他船只的）雾角, 雾喇叭( foghorn的复数形式 )

fogies.translation: n. （思想）守旧者, 抱残守缺的人( fogey的名词复数 ); 守旧者, 赶不上时代的人( fogy的名词复数 )

foglight.translation: 雾灯（汽车在大雾中用的头灯）

foglights.translation: (foglight 的复数)  雾灯（汽车在大雾中用的头灯）

fogram.translation: n. 过时的人, 守旧的人

fogrum.translation: n. 过时的人, 守旧的人

fogs.definition:
n droplets of water vapor suspended in the air near the ground
n an atmosphere in which visibility is reduced because of a cloud of some substance
n confusion characterized by lack of clarity
v make less visible or unclear
fogs.translation: n. 雾( fog的名词复数 ); 迷惘, 困惑

fogy.definition: n someone whose style is out of fashion
fogy.translation: n. 守旧者, 赶不上时代的人

fogyish.definition: s. (used pejoratively) out of fashion; old fashioned
fogyish.translation: a. 守旧的, 旧头脑的

fogyism.definition: n. The principles and conduct of a fogy.
fogyism.translation: n. 守旧, 保守思想(或行为)
